title: Our Teams — Utsah Events | Bardoli, Gujarat
description: Meet the team behind Utsah Events — the planners, coordinators, and creatives crafting celebrations in Bardoli, Gujarat.
headExtra:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,300;1,400;1,600&family=Cinzel:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=DM+Sans:wght@200;300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/style.css?v=85">
<style>
    .team-page { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
    .nav__logo { cursor: pointer; }
    @media (min-width: 431px) {
      #nav { transition: opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) !important; }
      #dropdownBtn { transition: opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 430px) {
      .nav { pointer-events: all !important; }
      .nav__logo { pointer-events: all !important; display: block; }
    }

    /* HERO */
    .team-hero {
      height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0 40px;
    }
    .team-hero__label {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #FFD700;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .team-hero__title {
      font-family: 'Cinzel', serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 6.5vw, 5.5rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.0;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    /* Desktop only — matches the Times New Roman treatment on the home
       hero. Scoped above the tablet breakpoint so phone/tablet keep
       their existing Cinzel untouched. */
    @media (min-width: 1025px) {
      .team-hero__title { font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; }
    }
    .team-hero__title span { color: var(--maroon); }
    .team-hero__sub {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.8vw, 1.15rem);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 600;
      max-width: 420px;
      line-height: 1.8;
    }
    .team-hero__divider {
      width: 60px;
      height: 2px;
      background: #FFD700;
      margin: 24px auto 0;
    }
    /* Scroll cue — phones only, see media query below */
    .team-hero__scroll { display: none; }

    /* ALL TEAMS SECTION */
    .teams-section {
      padding: 80px 40px 60px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .teams-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .team-card-wrap {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    /* Mini card — compact version */
    .ig-mini {
      width: 100%;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-radius: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    }
    .ig-mini__topbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
    }
    .ig-mini__handle {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #111;
    }
    .ig-mini__dots { color: #bbb; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 2px; }
    .ig-mini__profile {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 14px;
    }
    .ig-mini__avatar-ring {
      width: 56px; height: 56px; flex-shrink: 0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #833ab4, #fd1d1d, #fcb045);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .ig-mini__avatar {
      width: 50px; height: 50px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #111;
      border: 2px solid #fff;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
    }
    .ig-mini__stats {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .ig-mini__stat {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1px;
    }
    .ig-mini__stat-num {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #111;
    }
    .ig-mini__stat-label {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      color: #777;
    }
    .ig-mini__name {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #111;
      padding: 0 14px 6px;
    }
    .ig-mini__follow {
      display: block;
      margin: 0 14px 14px;
      padding: 8px;
      background: #0095f6;
      color: #fff;
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-align: center;
      border-radius: 8px;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: opacity 0.2s;
    }
    .ig-mini__follow:hover { opacity: 0.85; }
    .ig-mini__grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 2px;
    }
    .ig-mini__grid-item {
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
    }
    .ig-mini__grid-item img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform 0.4s ease;
      display: block;
    }
    .ig-mini__grid-item:hover img { transform: scale(1.08); }
    .team-card-sentence {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.6;
      padding: 0 8px;
    }
    .team-card-sentence a {
      color: #FFD700;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .team-card-sentence a:hover { color: #ffffff; }

    /* PEOPLE SECTION */
    .people-section {
      padding: 40px 40px 50px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .people-label {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #FFD700;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .people-title {
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }
    .people-grid-wrap {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: 24px;
      padding: 48px 40px;
      color: #ffffff;

      /* Translucent frosted surface — gold-tinted */
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(150,120,20,0.22) 0%, rgba(60,40,5,0.3) 100%);

      /* Creates a distinct, physical glass edge */
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

      /* Double box-shadow: outer shadow for depth, inset shadow for edge illumination */
      box-shadow:
        0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.35),
        inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.15);

      /* Standard glassmorphism fallback + layer initialization */
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
    }
    /* Isolate and apply the liquid distortion map on its own layer */
    .people-grid-wrap::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
      backdrop-filter: url(#liquidGlass);
    }
    .people-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
      width: 100%;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .people-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 32px 0; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 500px) {
      .people-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 32px 0; }
    }
    .people-card {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.25s;
    }
    .people-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); }
    .people-card:hover .people-avatar { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(201,168,76,0.4); }
    .people-see-more { display: none; } /* mobile only, see media query below */
    .people-avatar {
      width: 72px;
      height: 72px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--maroon), #cc2200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .people-name {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #ffffff;
    }
    .people-role {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #f0d9a8;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* PEOPLE POPUP */
    .people-popup-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 20000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: opacity 0.3s, visibility 0.3s;
    }
    .people-popup-overlay.open { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }
    .people-popup {
      border-radius: 24px;
      padding: 48px 40px;
      max-width: 420px;
      width: 90%;
      text-align: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      position: relative;
      transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.97);
      transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);

      /* Translucent frosted surface — maroon-tinted, matches hamburger menu glass */
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,15,15,1) 0%, rgba(20,5,5,1) 100%);

      /* Creates a distinct, physical glass edge */
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

      /* Double box-shadow: outer shadow for depth, inset shadow for edge illumination */
      box-shadow:
        0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
        inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

      /* Standard glassmorphism fallback + layer initialization */
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
    }
    /* Isolate and apply the liquid distortion map on its own layer */
    .people-popup::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
      backdrop-filter: url(#liquidGlass);
    }
    .people-popup-overlay.open .people-popup { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
    .people-popup__close {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px; right: 20px;
      background: none; border: none;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      line-height: 1;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .people-popup__close:hover { color: #fff; }
    .people-popup__avatar {
      width: 90px;
      height: 90px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--maroon), #cc2200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: 2.2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
    }
    .people-popup__name {
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .people-popup__role {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 2.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--maroon);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .people-popup__divider {
      width: 50px;
      height: 1px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      margin: 0 auto 24px;
    }
    .people-popup__bio {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.85;
    }

    /* INSTAGRAM PROFILE CARD */
    .ig-profile {
      width: 100%;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-radius: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    }

    /* Profile top bar */
    .ig-profile__topbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #efefef;
    }
    .ig-profile__handle {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #111;
    }
    .ig-profile__more { color: #888; }
    .ig-profile__more svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    /* Profile header */
    .ig-profile__header {
      padding: 12px 12px 10px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .ig-profile__avatar-wrap { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .ig-profile__avatar-ring {
      width: 64px; height: 64px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #833ab4, #fd1d1d, #fcb045);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .ig-profile__avatar {
      width: 58px; height: 58px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #111;
      border: 2px solid #fff;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
    }
    .ig-profile__stats { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex: 1; }
    .ig-profile__stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1px; }
    .ig-profile__stat-num {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #111;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .ig-profile__stat-label {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      color: #555;
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    /* Bio */
    .ig-profile__bio { padding: 0 12px 10px; }
    .ig-profile__name {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #111;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .ig-profile__desc {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      color: #333;
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .ig-profile__link {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      color: #00376b;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    /* Buttons */
    .ig-profile__actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px 10px; }
    .ig-profile__btn {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 6px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-align: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      text-decoration: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 4px;
      transition: opacity 0.2s;
    }
    .ig-profile__btn:hover { opacity: 0.85; }
    .ig-profile__btn--follow { background: #0095f6; color: #ffffff; }
    .ig-profile__btn--msg { background: #efefef; color: #111111; }
    .ig-profile__btn--chevron { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 30px; background: #efefef; color: #111; }

    /* Grid */
    .ig-profile__grid-item {
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
    }
    .ig-profile__grid-item img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
      display: block;
    }
    .ig-profile__grid-item:hover img { transform: scale(1.1); }
    .ig-profile__grid-item__overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background 0.3s;
    }
    .ig-profile__grid-item:hover .ig-profile__grid-item__overlay {
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    }
    .ig-profile__grid-item__overlay svg {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(0.8);
      transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
      color: #fff;
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
    }
    .ig-profile__grid-item:hover .ig-profile__grid-item__overlay svg {
      opacity: 1; transform: scale(1);
    }

    /* LIGHTBOX */
    .team-lightbox {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.92);
      z-index: 9999;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.3s;
    }
    .team-lightbox.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
    .team-lightbox__img {
      max-width: 90vw;
      max-height: 90vh;
      border-radius: 16px;
      object-fit: contain;
      box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      transform: scale(0.92);
      transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
    }
    .team-lightbox.open .team-lightbox__img { transform: scale(1); }
    .team-lightbox__close {
      position: absolute;
      top: 24px; right: 28px;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 2rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      line-height: 1;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      opacity: 0.7;
      transition: opacity 0.2s;
    }
    .team-lightbox__close:hover { opacity: 1; }
    .team-lightbox__prev,
    .team-lightbox__next {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border: none;
      color: #fff;
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .team-lightbox__prev:hover,
    .team-lightbox__next:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }
    .team-lightbox__prev { left: 20px; }
    .team-lightbox__next { right: 20px; }

    /* Team label */
    .team-label {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .team-title {
      font-family: var(--heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4vw, 4rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.0;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .team-title span { color: var(--maroon); }

    /* CTA */
    .team-cta {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto 80px;
      padding: 0 40px;
    }
    .team-cta__card {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 32px 36px;
      text-align: center;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      gap: 24px;
      color: #ffffff;

      /* Translucent frosted surface — maroon-tinted */
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,15,15,0.399) 0%, rgba(20,5,5,0.399) 100%);

      /* Creates a distinct, physical glass edge */
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

      /* Double box-shadow: outer shadow for depth, inset shadow for edge illumination */
      box-shadow:
        0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
        inset 0 4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

      /* Standard glassmorphism fallback + layer initialization */
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px) saturate(140%);
    }
    /* Isolate and apply the liquid distortion map on its own layer */
    .team-cta__card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      border-radius: inherit;
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
      backdrop-filter: url(#liquidGlass);
    }
    .team-cta__title {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 1.6vw, 1.15rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      line-height: 1.4;
      text-align: center;
      margin: 0;
    }
    .team-cta__btn {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 11px 28px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.95) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.8) 100%);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      color: var(--maroon);
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border-radius: 100px;
      text-decoration: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;
    }
    .team-cta__btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); opacity: 0.9; }

    @media (max-width: 500px) {
      .team-section { padding: 80px 20px 60px; }
      .ig-profile { border-radius: 18px; }
      .team-cta { padding: 0 20px; }
      .team-cta__card { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
      .team-cta__title { text-align: center; }
    }

    /* ===== PHONES (≤430px) — iPhone 14/15/16, Pixel, Galaxy S ===== */
    @media (max-width: 430px) {
      /* Hero */
      /* Hero — compact type matching the about/events/contact/socials heroes */
      .team-hero { padding: 100px 20px 48px; min-height: 100svh; position: relative; }
      .team-hero__label { font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 2px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
      .team-hero__title { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 7vw, 2.1rem); line-height: 1.05; margin-bottom: 0; }
      .team-hero__sub { font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 100%; margin-top: 10px; }
      .team-hero__divider { display: none; } /* golden line removed */

      /* Scroll cue — glowing, pulsing star + label pinned to the hero bottom */
      .team-hero__scroll {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        position: absolute;
        bottom: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
        left: 50%;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        font-family: var(--body);
        font-size: 0.6rem;
        font-weight: 900;
        letter-spacing: 0.2em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #c9a84c;
        text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(201,168,76,0.9), 0 0 24px rgba(201,168,76,0.5);
        transition: opacity 0.35s ease;
      }
      .team-hero__scroll-star {
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        line-height: 1;
        text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(201,168,76,1), 0 0 24px rgba(201,168,76,0.7), 0 0 44px rgba(201,168,76,0.4);
        animation: teamStarPulse 2s ease infinite;
      }
      @keyframes teamStarPulse {
        0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1); }
        50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.15); }
      }
      .team-hero__scroll span { display: none; }

      /* Team section header */
      .team-section { padding: 36px 20px 48px; }
      .people-section { padding: 36px 20px 48px; }
      .people-label { font-size: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
      .people-title { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 6.5vw, 2.2rem); margin-bottom: 28px; }

      /* People grid wrapper */
      .people-grid-wrap { padding: 28px 16px; border-radius: 18px; }
      .people-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px 0; }
      .people-avatar { width: 56px; height: 56px; font-size: 1.2rem; }
      .people-name { font-size: 0.75rem; }
      .people-role { font-size: 0.65rem; }

      /* Only the first 3 cards show by default; the rest sit behind See More */
      .people-card--extra { display: none; }
      .people-grid-wrap.expanded .people-card--extra { display: flex; }
      .people-see-more {
        display: block;
        margin: 24px auto 0;
        background: none;
        border: none;
        font-family: var(--body);
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #c9a84c;
        cursor: pointer;
      }

      /* Popup */
      .people-popup { padding: 36px 20px; width: calc(100vw - 32px); border-radius: 20px; }
      .people-popup__avatar { width: 64px; height: 64px; font-size: 1.6rem; }
      .people-popup__name { font-size: 1.5rem; }

      /* IG profile */
      .ig-profile { padding: 16px; border-radius: 16px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; }
      .ig-profile__avatar { width: 56px; height: 56px; font-size: 1.4rem; }
      .ig-profile__stats { justify-content: center; }

      /* ig-mini grid */
      .ig-mini-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4px; }

      /* CTA — removed on mobile */
      .team-cta { display: none; }
    }

    /* ===== SMALLEST PHONES (≤375px) — iPhone SE, Galaxy A-series ===== */
    @media (max-width: 375px) {
      .team-hero { padding: 90px 16px 40px; }
      .team-hero__title { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 8vw, 1.9rem); }
      .team-section, .people-section { padding: 28px 16px 40px; }
      .people-grid-wrap { padding: 20px 12px; }
      .people-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 20px 0; }
      .people-avatar { width: 52px; height: 52px; font-size: 1.1rem; }
      .team-cta { padding: 0 12px; }
      .team-cta__card { padding: 22px 16px; }
    }
  </style>
